EVIDENCE-BACKED STUDENT ACHIEVEMENTS
Built at SRM

Student teams, engineering ventures, and start-ups founded by SRM students and alumni. Every fact is cited to an official SRM document or published report with capture dates and source tiers.

Source tier note: Facts labeled Sourced come from SRM’s official 2026-27 admission brochure or published reports. They represent SRM’s self-reported figures rather than independently audited metrics.
STARTUP
4 documented facts
Abhinava Rizel: EV motors

Brochure says the founders are alumni of the Mechanical and Automotive departments.

“Developed electric-vehicle motors using a hybrid radial-flux design between synchronous reluctance (SynRM) and permanent-magnet synchronous (PMSM) motors.”

Related:
Mechanical Engineering
Automobile Engineering

STARTUP
4 documented facts
Torus Robotics: defence ground vehicles

Brochure says the founders are alumni of the Mechatronics department.

“Designs and delivers fully electric unmanned ground vehicles with a 6-degree-of-freedom robotic arm for Indian defence services.”

Related:
Mechatronics Engineering

Brochure says the founders are alumni of the Mechatronics department.

“Works on AR/VR, motors and actuators; its Neur XR Studios builds enterprise XR solutions.”

Paperplane: digital clinics on WhatsApp

Brochure names the School of Computing, not a programme.

SureLocal: pharmacy supply chain

Founder studied at the School of Pharmacy, outside the B.Tech programmes.

Not tied to a B.Tech programme

TEAM
5 documented facts
Team Camber Racing: Formula Student

SRM Spectrum (Volume 19 Number 2) names student leaders from these three departments. No other departments are named.

“Named National Champion at Formula Bharat 2026, with first place in Endurance, Skidpad, Autocross, Acceleration, Engineering Design, Fuel Economy, and Sustainability & Best Practices.”
